Overview

Chiba is a city in with a population of 982,000. A coastal city east of Tokyo with a major port, Narita Airport access, and the magical Disney Resort. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
